notes: v1.14.552 — LEGACY-RETIRE STAGE 6.7: SCAN IS DECOUPLED, AND STAGE 6 IS COMPLETE. pg-scan content is now AUTHORED inside #wk-scan; redesign_homeScan and its registration are deleted and the shell goes with them. ⭐ THERE ARE NOW ZERO redesign_home* FUNCTIONS IN THE FILE. The redesign no longer borrows a single node from the legacy house at boot — every #rf-* and #wk-* surface is populated from its own markup. That was the entire point of Stage 6, and it is what turns Stage 7 (deleting redesign_isOn, phantom_legacy, ?legacy=1 and --tabnav-h) into a removal rather than a rebuild. SCAN went last deliberately: it is a primary nav pillar, so the decouple pattern was proven on six cheaper organs before it was pointed at the scanner. Every id is verbatim, because ScanDispatch, the BT scan-gun wiring and showPage(scan) all resolve them by id. ⚠ VISIBLE UNDER ?legacy=1: the legacy house loses SCAN, the eighth and final organ. Eight organs across seven ships: Issue Log, HW Ref matrix, CLI/IB, Optics, Runbook + Hardware (one ship), Cage Nut Compass, SCAN.
